about: The second independent verifier's 53 SYNTHETIC probes (27 keep, 26 refuse), frozen as written. Driven through row_from_candidate as a Learn Q&A candidate is built (parent_title = report_title = title, report_text = clean_html(title + ' ' + body)). 'expected' is this change's decision: kept, refused, or a declared residual class R1R-nn (admitted by main and by this change alike, ledger AUX-076).
